pages.setting: Bakery interior beside the refrigerator and delivery area
pages.mainAction: The baker sets a colorful three-tier fruit cake on a delivery cart as it begins to wobble; Dini approaches while the child smiles.
pages.heroObject: three-tier fruit cake on delivery cart

pages.setting: Uneven stone street outside the bakery
pages.mainAction: The child moves the bouncing cart along the stones while Dini darts from side to side to support the swaying cake.

pages.setting: Uneven stone street with one raised stone
pages.mainAction: The cart jolts over the raised stone; Dini grips it firmly while the child watches a strawberry begin sliding across the cake top.

pages.setting: Uneven stone street continuing toward the market
pages.mainAction: Dini carefully releases the cart, and its natural sway rolls the displaced strawberry back to the center as the child notices.
continuityAnchors: strawberry near edge of cake top

pages.setting: Crowded market passage between orange crates and potted plants
pages.mainAction: As Dini shifts crates and pots to clear a path, oranges spill everywhere and the broom man turns among the rolling fruit.

pages.setting: Cluttered market passage filled with shifted crates, pots, and loose oranges
pages.mainAction: Dini discovers a moved crate blocking the cart while the laughing child guides the tilting cake slowly through the remaining gaps without losing any fruit.

pages.setting: Long uneven wooden bridge above a small stream
pages.mainAction: Dini holds two uneven planks still, stopping the cart, while a cherry starts sliding until the child gives the cart a gentle push and rocks it back.

pages.setting: Long wooden bridge with alternating raised and lowered planks
pages.mainAction: The child tests the cart's rocking motion more slowly while Dini releases the planks and walks beside the cart without trying to steady the bridge.

pages.setting: Short bumpy slope overlooking the picnic below
pages.mainAction: The child places both hands on the cart at the top of the slope while Dini studies the bumps, the cake, and the child, then waits.
pages.heroObject: cake cart poised above the slope

pages.setting: Bumpy slope descending toward the picnic
pages.mainAction: The child guides the cart through the bumps at a steady rhythm as Dini runs alongside, and the three cake tiers begin rotating gently at different rates.

pages.setting: Open picnic square beside the grassy gathering
pages.mainAction: The cart arrives as the three colorful cake tiers complete their separate turns and stop with the strawberry centered on top; the birthday child claps while Dini laughs.
continuityAnchors: three tiers rotating at different rates

pages.setting: Grassy picnic area beside the celebration table
pages.mainAction: The baker cuts the first slice while the child sits beside Dini; Dini reaches toward the lifting tablecloth, pauses, and lets it flutter as the cherry on Dini's slice gently wobbles.
continuityAnchors: same three-tier cake now being served
